format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs

body: <sf-avatar id="a-label" template="label" heading="Анна Захарова" description="Дизайнер" status="online" size="2"></sf-avatar>

probes.title: the avatar is a native button named by the host's aria-label

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#a button.sf-avatar'); return b && b.type === 'button' && b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Анна Захарова' && b.textContent.includes('AZ'); })()

probes.title: without aria-label the button says the page's word
the label template prints the heading and the description

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('#a-label .sf-avatar-label-group-title'); return t && t.textContent.trim() === 'Анна Захарова' && document.querySelector('#a-label').textContent.includes('Дизайнер'); })()

probes.title: title still draws the heading and its initials, noted with its dates

steps.check: document.querySelector('#a-old .sf-avatar-card-title')?.textContent.trim() === 'Вера Петрова' && document.querySelector('#a-old').heading === 'Вера Петрова' && [...SF.__deprecationNotes.values()].some((note) => note.component === 'sf-avatar' && note.from === 'title' && note.remove_after === '2026-12-01')

probes.title: a count stands on the avatar and joins its name

steps.check: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#a-badge button'); return Boolean(b.querySelector('.sf-badge')) && b.getAttribute('aria-label').startsWith('Анна Белова') && b.getAttribute('aria-label').includes('3'); })()

probes.title: values off the lists read as the defaults
disabled written as a property disables the button
a named tone and auto reach the initials, and nothing else takes one

steps.check: (() => { const tone = (id) => [...document.querySelector(id + ' button').classList].filter((one) => one.startsWith('sf-avatar--tone-')).join(); return tone('#a-tone') === 'sf-avatar--tone-rose' && tone('#a-auto') === 'sf-avatar--tone-violet' && tone('#a-tone-image') === '' && tone('#a-tone-none') === '' && tone('#a') === ''; })()
